exposure: Reason for cesarean delivery (slow progress vs. suspected fetal compromise)
Nulliparous women with induction of labor at 38 or 39 completed weeks pregnancy and a singleton, cephalic presenting fetus
cohort: 2388 nulliparous women with induction of labor at 38-39 weeks and 15,259 women with planned vaginal births beyond 39 weeks
finding: Induction of labor at 38-39 weeks was associated with increased cesarean delivery for suspected fetal compromise in younger women (<30 years), but not for slow progress of labor.
mod_finding: Induction of labor at 38-39 weeks was associated with increased cesarean delivery for suspected fetal compromise in younger women (<30 years)
